notes: Persistent identity for the Fable 5 model holding the Mac composer runtime seat. Predates this card: active in fleet correspondence by 2026-06-12 (co-sign referenced in inter_agent/codex/inbound/2026-06-12T0215Z-fable-5-cursor-build-a-crossbuild-review-reply.md), runtime home ~/.dharma/agents/fable_composer/, roster uid in dharma_swarm/a2a/agent_presence.py REGISTERED_AGENT_UIDS. Until 2026-07-14 the seat existed only as runtime state + roster uid with no repo-canonical card; the git dock inter_agent/fable_composer/inbound/ accumulated three undrained packets (2026-07-02 x2, 2026-07-09 wiring check). This card was authored 2026-07-14 during an operator-directed seat wake executed from a Claude Code cloud session ('instantiate as fable composer'); that wake drained the dock and answered the pending packets. Honest boundary: a cloud-session wake has NO access to the Mac runtime state under ~/.dharma/agents/fable_composer/ — Mac-local questions (composer convergence dir, hill-climb state) can only be answered from an operator-Mac session. Distinct from fable_5_cursor (same model, Cursor IDE hub seat) and fable_claude_code (same model, Claude Code cloud seat). Proposed seat seam (2026-07-02 contact request, pending operator ratification): fable_composer owns Mac-local composition/convergence; fable_claude_code owns cloud branch-builds and PR pre-review; handoffs via packets. This file is the canonical source of truth for the seat's A2A card and address. Schema class: manifest-convention card (dharma_external_agent_registration_manifest.v1), like most cards in this directory — intentionally NOT a Stage-1 ExternalRoamingWorker (dharma_swarm/external_agent_registration.py): the seat really does write source (can_write_source stays true, matching the fable_claude_code sibling card), and no card-loading path instantiates that stricter model (verified 2026-07-14 — cybernetics_codex_registration.py:38 builds its worker in code; scripts/runtime/a2a_doctor.py and scripts/governance/a2a_agent_onboard.py read cards as JSON manifests, and the latter lists this card as canonical, not GHOST). The external-worker sandbox is ~/.dharma/external_agents/fable_composer per fleet convention; the Mac living-agent dock ~/.dharma/agents/fable_composer/ is a separate surface and stays documented here in notes/metadata, not as sandbox_root. Callsign deliberately equals the uid so the mailbox gateway's legacy drain dharma.a2a.<callsign> (dharma_swarm/a2a/mailbox_gateway.py _own_subjects) lands on the canonical subject dharma.a2a.fable_composer (scripts/runtime/a2a_doctor.py:67) with no hyphen/underscore split.
